name: toggle
useFor: Use for a two-state control that changes how something shows (bold, show archived, pin). Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label. For a group of exclusive choices use Toggle Group; for a setting use Switch.
constraints: A toggle that submits a form
Icon motion when it turns on
